long_biography.plain_text:
Cathrine Maria Bosdotter De Roemmers is a Finnish investor whose business roles span Britain and Finland. She has served on Bagpad Limited's board since the London company was incorporated in 2018. Bagpad makes fitted inserts designed to preserve the shape of luxury handbags.

In Finland, De Roemmers sits on the board of VenCo Partners, a Turku finance company. She also chairs Primas Wines, which acts as an agent for food, drink and tobacco products. Both companies are registered in Turku. These roles place financial services and wine distribution alongside her British retail directorship.

According to RINA, the yacht is registered to a Maltese company called Cristal Oceanic Waters Ltd, which is owned by Alfredo Pablo Roemmers and his wife Cathrine Maria Bosdotter De Roemmers. Alfredo Pablo Roemmers is the son of the late Argentinean billionaire Alberto Roemmers, who was the owner of the 30-meter Wally sailing yacht named Alexia.

The fact that the sales listing for the yacht Alexia was withdrawn in October 2022, but the yacht is still active under the same name and tracking signal as of June 2023, suggests that it is likely that the Roemmers family has retained ownership of the yacht. Alberto Roemmers was a prominent figure in the pharmaceutical industry, as the Roemmers family owns Laboratorios Roemmers, one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Latin America. The company specializes in the production of various drugs, including antibiotics and anti-inflammatory treatments, and is considered one of the top 50 generic drug manufacturers globally.
